html:
Ceramic coating is a wise investment when it comes to protecting one of your most valuable assets.

To find out exactly how much is ceramic coating, the best option is to talk to your local window tinting team.

How much ceramic coating is for cars, depends on the vehicle size, but EliteX Ceramic Surface Protection starts from $895. Check in-store for details and a quote.

Tint a Car has been providing tinting services in Australia for over 40 years and is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We use the very best products for all our services which include car window tinting, home & office window tinting, car wraps & ceramic coating and all installations are done by professionally trained installers. Here is why you should invest in ceramic coating for your car and how to contact us to find out how much ceramic coating is.

Benefits of Ceramic Coating For Your Car: EliteX

Our ceramic coating, EliteX is a permanent, once-off application that is applied professionally to your car.

It has been tested, proven and globally certified to the stringent standards set out for Boeing compatible products and is 4 times more durable than any quartz-based product.

Our EliteX exterior ceramic coating offers extreme hardness and ultimate durability with a revolutionary permanent high gloss finish for an amazing showroom shine. Your car’s exterior is protected against damage caused by:

  • Bird and bat droppings
  • Bugs and sap
  • Spills and stains
  • Weather-induced oxidisation, fading and loss of gloss
  • Road dirt and grime

Our EliteX interior ceramic coating features a specialised technology that penetrates and bonds with individual fibres creating a super durable coating with water and stain repellent properties. The coating protects against common stains caused by makeup, muddy shoes and commonly consumed foods & liquids. It is suitable for use on fabric, vinyl, leather, and plastic surfaces.

So when considering how much is ceramic coating for cars, you can see why ceramic coating is a great investment that not only protects your car… but also helps to retain its value.

Find Out How Much It Is To Ceramic Coat Your Car

Use our Store Finder to find your nearest Tint a Car store and speak to your local experts who will be able to tell you exactly how much it is to ceramic coat your car. If you’d like to find out more about our ceramic coating, you can call 13TINT to speak with a member of our customer service team who can answer any questions you have. They can also provide info on how much it is to ceramic coat your car as well.
